assessments.omission_note: 朱桓击败曹仁的关键战况
assessments.reason: This omits the decisive battle in which Zhu Huan defeats Cao Ren, changing a major military outcome in the Wu–Wei conflict.
assessments.required_fix: Add that Zhu Huan ambushed and routed Cao Ren after killing Chang Diao, forcing Cao Ren to retreat.

assessments.omission_note: 刘备驾崩及刘禅正式即位、改元等细节
assessments.reason: This omits Liu Bei’s death and Liu Chan’s formal succession and change of era name, which are essential events establishing the chronology and political transition before the five-route invasion.
assessments.required_fix: Add Liu Bei’s death, Liu Chan’s formal enthronement, the 建興 era name, and the related succession details.
